subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Revises numbers 1 to 6 and number words one to six; matches number, word and dots on a die

show.line: Look at the dice. Count the dots. One, two, three, four, five, six. Six dots!

rounds.prompt: Count the dots on this dice. Tap the number.
Tap the number that matches these dots.
How many dots? Say the number.
Match each picture to its number. Put each one in its group.
Throw the dice! Count the dots.
One, two, three, four, five. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Six! One, two, three, four, five, six.

hints: Touch each dot as you count.
The dots and the number say the same thing.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read the dice.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three, four, five. Five dots!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There are six dots. One more than five.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count the dots together. One, two, three, four, five, six!

parent_line: Can match dice dots to numbers 1 to 6.
